summary: Implemented DapperMovieCatalogRepository with all five IMovieCatalogRepository methods: GetCountAsync (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM movies), MovieExistsAsync (SELECT COUNT(*) WHERE hash), InsertMovieAsync (INSERT IGNORE with all NOT-NULL columns and empty-metadata defaults), FilenameExistsAsync (SELECT COUNT(*) WHERE filename), AddFilenameAsync (INSERT IGNORE).

InsertMovieAsync populates all columns with correct defaults: studio='', name='', label='', description='', rating=0, watch_count=0, open_count=0, last_watched=NULL, review='no', review_message=NULL, cache=''. Uses INSERT IGNORE to handle race-condition duplicate hashes gracefully (per IMovieCatalogRepository contract).

AddFilenameAsync uses INSERT IGNORE — required because movies_filenames.hash has a UNIQUE constraint in the live schema (one filename per hash). Two concurrent callers cannot both succeed for the same hash.

Added DapperMovieCatalogRepositoryTests.cs (VideoIndexer.Infrastructure.Tests/Library) — 9 live-DB SkippableFacts covering: insert with metadata defaults, duplicate insert no-throw, MovieExistsAsync false/true, GetCountAsync non-negative + increases on insert, FilenameExistsAsync false, AddFilenameAsync persists + duplicate no-throw. Uses VI_TEST_MCR_ prefix for cleanup isolation.
Build: 0 warnings, 0 errors. Test run: 86/86 unit, 79/83 infrastructure (4 expected SkippableFact skips), 48/48 app = 213 total, 0 failures.

summary: Reviewed 2 files (1 implementation, 1 test). 0 Critical, 0 High, 0 Medium, 2 Low, 1 Info. Security sign-off: PASS. Key positive: all SQL queries parameterized via Dapper; INSERT IGNORE correctly applied for deduplication. Low findings: absence of ILogger (no repo-layer audit trail) and no null guards on public parameters. Cleanest implementation in the WP set.

comments.note: Low — A09 (Security Logging & Monitoring) | DapperMovieCatalogRepository.cs: No ILogger dependency — InsertMovieAsync (movie creation) and AddFilenameAsync (filename association) produce no audit trail at the repository layer. Callers are expected to log these events. Remediation: inject ILogger<DapperMovieCatalogRepository> and emit LogDebug entries for insert operations, or document that caller logging is the expected pattern.

Low — A04 (Insecure Design) | DapperMovieCatalogRepository.cs: No null validation on hash or filename parameters. Null hash passed to MovieExistsAsync or InsertMovieAsync propagates to Dapper/MySQL (NULL != NULL in SQL, so a null-hash movie would never be found). Null filename in FilenameExistsAsync or AddFilenameAsync similarly produces silent incorrect behavior. Remediation: add ArgumentException.ThrowIfNullOrWhiteSpace guards on all public method parameters. Low risk given this is an internal service boundary.

Info — A03 (Injection) | DapperMovieCatalogRepository.cs: All 5 SQL queries confirmed parameterized via Dapper (@Hash, @Filename). No string concatenation of user input. No SQL injection risk. INSERT IGNORE pattern is correct and intentional for race-condition deduplication per IMovieCatalogRepository contract.
